title: Newhalo hero
description: A window-tall black panel inset 6–10px from the edge with 8px corners, filled edge to edge by a video slot that drifts down ~108px as you scroll the first screen. A giant 280px wordmark sits bottom-left on desktop, a 64px (or two-line 100px) title bottom-right, and an orange play button trails the cursor; on phones the title and play button stack bottom-left.
notes: sized by the window (h-svh); pair it with newhalo-header, which floats over it
always dark (wraps itself in .dark); tone warm suits an orange video
name: newhalo-hero

props.name: title
props.description: the title at the bottom right (bottom left on phones)

props.name: titleSize
props.description: md: one 64px line (landing) · xl: a 100px block set further right (product page)

props.name: wordmark
props.description: the giant word along the bottom left, desktop only; leave out to hide it

props.name: play
props.description: the orange play button: follows the cursor on desktop, sits under the title on phones

props.name: media
props.description: the photo or video filling the panel. Empty shows the placeholder.

props.name: tone
props.description: placeholder look: deep (near-black) panel or warm (an amber→red wash)
